data.title: Give your writing a *home*
data.subtitle: A project keeps your style rules for every draft inside it.

rows.label: + New Project
rows.detail: Name it, for example Plain writing
Add files: an example of your own writing

steps: Go to **claude.ai/projects** and click **+ New Project**
Click **Set project instructions** and paste your style instruction
Click **+** to add one example of your own writing
data.note: Drawn from Anthropic's help pages, not a screenshot. Your screen may differ.
